title: Euler-Mascheroni Constant Irrationality
exact_target: Is the Euler--Mascheroni constant irrational? Is it also transcendental?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1511 (NUM-017). CC BY 4.0.
Jonathan Sondow, \emph{Criteria for Irrationality of Euler's Constant}, Proceedings of the American Mathematical Society 131 (2003), 3335--3344; arXiv:math/0209070v2, Section 1, equation (1).

Michel Waldschmidt, \emph{Open Diophantine Problems}, arXiv:math/0312440v2 (2004), Section 2.3, the Euler-constant irrationality question, and Section 3.1, the stronger non-period/transcendence question.
